crossRefs.note: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.
When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this…
When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did…
Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with…
All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn’t…
They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?
He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be…
Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of…
and Yahweh took me from following the flock, and Yahweh said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’

translations.web: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
translations.bsb: The Jews were amazed and asked, “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?”
translations.kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
translations.asv: The Jews therefore marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
